This is a straightforward navigation/exploration task where the agent must locate a blue_concrete block placed in the scene. It requires no deep Minecraft domain knowledge (no crafting recipes, no special tools), is easily observable (blue concrete has a distinctive bright blue color), and is clearly verifiable (the agent either finds and looks at it or doesn't). As a single task, no dependency chain is needed, but the task itself can be made interesting through scene design — placing the block in a location that requires some exploration to discover.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task. The player must navigate to the oak plank building and look at the blue concrete blocks on the back interior wall. The target is the center of the blue concrete placement at spawn-relative (5, 0, 9). max_distance=16 allows detection from the doorway or inside the building, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the blue concrete (not just nearby facing away).

scene_description: A grassy area with three structures: a main oak plank building (5x5 interior) containing blue concrete blocks on its back interior wall lit by a torch, a stone brick enclosure to the southwest, and a small cobblestone pillar to the west. A cow roams nearby. The blue concrete requires the player to approach and look into/enter the oak building through its 2-block-wide doorway.
task_text: Find the blue concrete blocks. Explore the area and look inside the buildings to locate them.
design_notes: Blue concrete (3 blocks wide, 1 high) placed on interior back wall (z=~9) of oak building. Building has 2-block-wide doorway (x=4-5, z=6) for easy entry. Torch at (5,2,8) illuminates interior. Stone brick structure at (-4,-4 to -2,-2) and cobblestone at (-6,3) serve as exploration distractors. Cow adds environmental realism. Player spawns ~6 blocks from building front.
